page.overview:
Who is Foot Soldiers?

The fought them in all five episodes of the first season, but as the 1987 TV series went on they are seen less and less because Shredder usually has to do things himself with and . This version of the Foot do not talk at all nor do they usually use ninja weapons but instead they usually use guns. A few episodes show them using swords and other weapons as well, especially during the first few episodes of the show.

In the cartoon, The Shredder once considered making more intelligent Foot Soldiers, capable of learning and taking decisions by themselves. One Foot Soldier named was the only robotic Foot Soldier who could talk and was seen in Season Four, in the episode was called "The Foot Soldiers are Revolting". However, the idea was quickly abandoned when he rebelled against The Shredder.

The Foot robot concept allowed the Turtles to destroy the Foot soldiers without any moral thoughts, allowing and to use their weapons more offensively. Meanwhile the series could keep its younger audience and remain a "family show".

In Turtles Forever, 1,000 Foot Soldiers were used to fight the 80s Turtles and the . They had a self-destruct sequence that distracted the Turtles while the 80s Shredder escaped with the and almost left Bebop and Rocksteady behind. The is shocked to see that the 80s Foot Soldiers are robots since the 2003 Foot Ninjas are humans. The says the 80s Foot Soldiers are exploding robots. The takes pleasure in destroying all of the 80s Foot Soldiers without his brothers help and was having fun doing it until the 80s threw a large boulder down and crushed several of the Foot Soldiers and said "Strike!" making the 2003 Raphael angry.
